Maya Chen: Heads-up 1026 Meridian QBR set for Tue Apr 14 10:00 PT. Need owners for slides, one short demo, exec ask, and a clean action log. Who's available to own the deck polish?

Tom Jenkins: I got deck polish. Will sync metrics, make exec bullets concise. Aim to push first draft by EOD Mon.

Alexa Patel: I'll take account health + onboarding status. Need latest activation funnel + integration blockers. @Maya which cohorts should I highlight?

Maya Chen: Focus on pilot cohort + top 10 expansion accounts by ARR. Also call out three high-risk renewals (Meridian, Harborline, Tactile) with suggested mitigations.

Noah Rossi: Demo lead here. Planning a 5-7min product walk; need sandbox data access and one happy-path flow. If infra not ready, we should have a recorded fallback.

Maya Chen: Good call. @Noah add a "demo runbook" slide so Ben can see the customer-facing flow.

QBR Bot: QBR template v2: https://redwood.slides/qbr-template-v2 :white_check_mark: 

Tom Jenkins: Placed placeholders in /QBRs/Meridian/2026-04-14. @Alexa if you don't have numbers I'll add dummy tables for now.

Alexa Patel: Pulling numbers now. Note: TTV improved ~18% QoQ; will include cohort table and 3 open integration tickets (refs: SUP-3321, INT-778, INF-4567).

Maya Chen: Commercial ask: propose 6-month discount vs. extra training credits. Need Sales approval to present to execs.

Ben Sales: I can present the commercial ask and run the negotiation framing. Let's sync 15m tomorrow.

Maya Chen: Owners so far: deck (Tom), account health (Alexa), demo (Noah), commercial ask (Ben). Please drop 2-3 risk bullets into the kickoff doc by EOD Mon.

Tom Jenkins: Quick review request: slide 2 needs fewer bullets, more exec-ready language. @Priya Singh can you help with copy?

Priya Singh: Yep, I'll trim and make bullets outcome-focused tonight.

Alexa Patel: Risk bullets for doc: 1) delayed platform adoption in two pilot sites, 2) low seat adoption vs. expected, 3) outstanding integration ticket blocking automation. Linking tickets in doc.

Noah Rossi: Sandbox refresh ticket #4567 filed with infra. If not green by rehearsal, plan B = recorded demo + live Q&A.

Maya Chen: Rehearsal slot: Mon Apr 13 11:00 PT (30m). Please RSVP in thread.

Tom Jenkins: In.

Alexa Patel: In.

Noah Rossi: In.

Ben Sales: In for last 15 mins.

Priya Singh: In.

Maya Chen: Action log template 620below; paste into /QBRs/Meridian/2026-04-14/kickoff.md and update as you complete items.


```
Owner | Action | Due
Tom J | Deck polish + exec bullets | 2026-04-13 EOD
Alexa P | Health metrics + cohort table | 2026-04-13 EOD
Noah R | Demo prep + fallback recording | 2026-04-13 EOD
Ben S | Renewal proposal + slide | 2026-04-13 12:00
Maya C | Exec alignment + runbook | 2026-04-13 EOD
Priya S | Slide copy + exec language | 2026-04-13 EOD
```
Tom Jenkins: Adding to doc now. Will ping when draft's ready for review.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. I'll follow up with Sales execs after rehearsal to confirm attendance. :sparkles:
